item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- “Didn’t expect to be back on field this early”- Tilak Varma thanks BCCI and CoE after India return
item.description: India batter Tilak Varma made his Men in Blue return when he played in the India v South Africa T20 World Cup 2026 warm-up game in Navi Mumbai on February 4. Varma had missed the recent T20I series against New Zealand after suffering an injury. He suffered a testicular torsion and had to undergo emergency surgery, getting ruled out of the Kiwi T20I series. item.description: The Indian men's cricket team is receiving a ton of support from the Indian women's team as they prepare for the 2026 T20 World Cup. item.title: “So much joy in seeing country’s flag going up”: Sunil Gavaskar vows to dance if India manage to defend T20 World Cup title
item.description: Two days ahead of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, the legendary Sunil Gavaskar has made a heartfelt promise.
